description: Validates that all required input fields are present and conform to their expected types and validation rules before the adapter call is made. Reads the required_fields schema from the adapter catalog and cross-checks the assembled input payload. Blocks the adapter call if any required field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails a regex or range rule. Returns a detailed validation report listing every failed field, making it easy to identify and fix data collection issues upstream. Prevents wasted API quota and avoids sending malformed requests that would return 400 errors.
use_cases: Checking PAN format before sending to CIBIL or Experian
Validating GSTIN format before hitting the GST API
Ensuring Aadhaar is 12 digits before KYC adapter call
Preventing malformed payment amounts from reaching Razorpay
Catching missing consent fields before bureau pulls
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters. Runs before field_encryption_hook and the outbound API call to catch data errors early and avoid wasted API calls.
trigger_condition: Before outbound adapter call; after credential resolution

input_parameters.description: Adapter version for schema rule selection
Required fields schema from adapter catalog

output.on_failure: Detailed validation_report per failed field; adapter call blocked

error_codes.HOOK_003: Field failed regex or range validation.
